verdict.rationale: Adyen documents in-person payments on its own terminals through the Terminal API and explicitly documents contactless acceptance via Tap to Pay on iPhone and on compatible smartphones. Chip acceptance and Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance are only implied by generic claims such as 'global and local payment methods' and test-card CVMs, never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chip/EMV card acceptance, explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay in-person wallet support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
Enables you to accept global and local payment methods.
